name: print-social-navy-trading-glossary-post-with-glowing-pill-cta
title: Navy '6 Words Every Trader Should Know' post with cyan highlight and glowing tilted pill
whatItIs: A dark navy portrait post with a huge bold uppercase headline ('6 WORDS EVERY TRADER SHOULD KNOW.') with the number and 'TRADER' in cyan, a slightly tilted pill 'Here's what they mean' with a glowing cyan orb, a 'Check full story' button and a contact footer bar.
whatItMeans: Big type and a single glow feel confident and click-worthy, framing finance education as a hook.
techniques: Colour the number and keyword in one accent within a white headline.
Tilt a pill slightly to add motion.
Add a single glowing orb as the light source.
Anchor contacts in a solid footer bar.

vocabulary.definition: A headline built to stop the scroll with a number or promise.
A blurred light spot used as an accent.
